text: Mopar is Stellantis N.V.'s original parts and accessories brand: Stellantis' Peugeot Sport calls it 'the benchmark brand for original parts and accessories for all Stellantis vehicles worldwide'.
short: Mopar is a brand of Stellantis N.V.

source.name: Peugeot Sport – Mopar partner page
source.quote: Mopar has established itself as the benchmark brand for original parts and accessories for all Stellantis vehicles worldwide.
